공통.시작: Create one still photograph. A cinematic film still from a Korean TV commercial, 16:9 frame.
공통.소연_얼굴: Use the four attached photos (Images 1 to 4) only as identity references for one Korean woman in her mid-thirties. Keep her face exactly the same in every detail: an oval face with softly rounded cheeks, dark brown almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, a straight and slightly wide nose bridge, a faint natural shadow under her eyes, bright warm-toned skin with natural makeup, natural rosy-brown lips, and dark brown collarbone-length hair with the ends curled softly inward. She looks like a real woman in her mid-thirties, not a young idol. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos. Do not add moles, freckles, marks, earrings, necklaces, tattoos, text, logos or watermarks.
공통.소연_옷: She wears a light-blue chambray shirt with the sleeves rolled once to the forearm, and a plain natural canvas apron tied at the waist with a neck strap.
공통.카페: Location: her small independent neighborhood café in Seoul, about thirty square meters. Along the back runs a light oak counter with a stainless espresso machine, a grinder, a stack of white cups and a small glass pastry case; behind the counter, a white tiled wall with open oak shelves holding glass jars of coffee beans and small green plants; a glass-door drinks fridge stands at the left end of the counter. The seating area has five small round white tables with light wood chairs. The front of the café is one large glass window with a glass door, facing a quiet street with ginkgo trees. White walls, pale wood floor, white pendant lamps hanging over the counter.
공통.카페_짧게: Location: her small independent neighborhood café in Seoul — light oak counter, white tiled wall with oak shelves, small round white tables, a large front window onto a quiet street.

Colors are muted, desaturated and cool — blue-grey, slate and pale grey-green, like the quiet first minutes of a story. No warm lamp light, no golden sunlight, no orange tones.
